MERGE INTO [Meta].[DependencyPayload] WITH (HOLDLOCK, UPDLOCK) AS target
USING ? AS source ON
	target.[ItemId] = source.[ItemId] 
WHEN MATCHED THEN 
	UPDATE SET 
	target.[JobId] = source.[JobId],
	target.[OperationId] = source.[OperationId],
	target.[Request] = source.[RequestBytes]
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
	INSERT ([ItemId],[JobId],[OperationId],[Request])
	VALUES (source.[ItemId], source.[JobId], source.[OperationId], source.[RequestBytes]);
